lessons.title: Welcome to Shadowing Practice
lessons.description: Practice listening, understanding, and speaking through four stages of English shadowing.

segments.text: Welcome to your English shadowing practice. Listen carefully to the speaker.
Pay attention to the rhythm of each sentence. Then try saying the words aloud.
Listen carefully to the speaker and notice how the words connect.
Repeat the sentences aloud and imitate the speaker's pronunciation.
